ok.paragraph: The most comprehensive assessment of background model uncertainties was carried out by Calore, Cholis, and Weniger~\cite{Calore:2014xka}, who evaluated the excess against 60 distinct Galactic diffuse emission models built using the GALPROP cosmic-ray propagation code. These models spanned a deliberately wide range of physical parameters --- cosmic-ray source distributions, gas maps, diffusion coefficients, re-acceleration, convection, interstellar radiation field normalizations, and magnetic field configurations --- to bracket the theoretical uncertainty envelope.
